label: World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS) Aphia records for Thompson chapters VI-XI marine taxa (2026-10-31)
bibliographic_citation: WoRMS Editorial Board (2026). World Register of Marine Species. Available from https://www.marinespecies.org at VLIZ. Accessed 2026-10-31. doi:10.14284/170

counts.description: taxa in this slice with an Aphia record (AphiaRecordsByName, exact match); unaccepted names carry the valid AphiaID and name

measurement_technique: WoRMS REST API AphiaRecordsByName (like=false, marine_only=false). Molluscan names are curated by MolluscaBase, which shares the Aphia identifiers.
role: accepted names, synonymy, rank and classification for the listed marine and fossil taxa (AphiaID)
